title: Link producer CARGO_TARGET_DIR to the slot's warm target dir
summary: Retry of job 20261106-202436-ch54 (dispatched, never verified, no findings, no candidate recorded): in the producer's cargo wrapper, while a slot is held, link the job's CARGO_TARGET_DIR path to <slots_dir>/<n>/target with athena_agent::env::BuildLink, run cargo, drop the link. Unslotted subcommands are unchanged. Audience: the operator whose disk fills with two concurrent jobs; the verifier checks via tests.

defaults_applied.how: Tests added; workspace cargo test, clippy and fmt --check required.
Tests observe the link during the command and its absence after.
One focused change in one module plus the changelog.
Criteria are checkable with cargo test/clippy/fmt and git diff.
Fixes the cause (producer builds in private dir) by reusing the checks' linking mechanism.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: crates/athena-cli/src/slot_exec.rs run() reads CargoShim::from_env, finds the real cargo, takes a Producer slot via SlotQueue::acquire only for build/test/clippy/check, then runs the child. crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs link_slot_target is the model (prepare, BuildLink::create(job_dir, path, slot_dir), warning and unlinked build on failure). crates/athena-agent/src/env.rs BuildLink::create runs check_build_dirs (D46, lexical) and Drop removes the link; CargoShim has dir (= job_dir/SHIM_DIR_NAME), slots_dir, note. crates/athena-core/src/state.rs slot_target(n) = build_slots_dir/n/target; Slot::index() in crates/athena-core/src/slots.rs. No record or data file is added, so no records validation is touched.

Job directory for BuildLink::create is derived as the parent of shim.dir; the slot target is slots_dir/<index>/target (created if missing, as make_target_dir does), matching the checks' layout. CARGO_TARGET_DIR is read through the lookup closure; absent or outside the job directory means a warning on stderr and cargo runs unlinked.

Prior job 20261106-202436-ch54: it had no recorded findings or candidate, so nothing is kept or dropped; this job redoes the whole work from the base. Its deliverable list is kept as is, including crates/athena-agent/src/env.rs, which changes only if a small helper or doc tweak is needed (unlikely).
Slot size-limit deletion (slot_max_gb) is not in the wrapper's settings; it is left out, as before.
No governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) need changing.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test in crates/athena-cli/src/slot_exec.rs: a slotted `build` run with a fake cargo observes the job's CARGO_TARGET_DIR path as a symlink resolving to <slots_dir>/<n>/target during the command, and the path is gone after run returns. Check: cargo test -p athena-cli slot_exec.

A test: two slotted runs one after the other in different job directories resolve to the same slot target directory, and a file written by the first run is still there in the second. Check: cargo test -p athena-cli slot_exec.
A test: unslotted subcommands (fmt, metadata) create no link, leave the slot directory untouched, and CARGO_TARGET_DIR is unchanged. Check: cargo test -p athena-cli slot_exec.

D46 still holds: BuildLink::create is called with the job directory; a test shows a CARGO_TARGET_DIR outside the job directory is refused (warning, cargo runs unlinked) while an inside path is linked. Check: cargo test -p athena-cli and cargo test -p athena-agent.
cargo test (workspace) passes, cargo clippy --all-targets is clean, cargo fmt --check passes.
CHANGELOG.md gains an entry stating only what the diff does: the producer's slotted cargo commands build in the slot's target directory via a temporary link; unslotted commands unchanged.

git diff shows changes only to crates/athena-cli/src/slot_exec.rs, CHANGELOG.md and possibly crates/athena-agent/src/env.rs; none to athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows or crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs.

out_of_scope: Changing checks.rs link_slot_target or the checks' behaviour
Slot size-limit deletion in the wrapper
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
Removing the producer's private build directory in the drain
